items.title: Flood victims at Kathmandu holding centres eager to return home (Photos)
items.summary: Kathmandu, November 5 People displaced by the August 26 floods in the Bhotekoshi River, which flows into the Trishuli River in Rasuwa, have been staying at holding centres in Kathmandu. The displaced families have been accommodated at various monasteries and centres across the capital. items.title: Vikram Misri says India ready to help rebuild Nepal’s flood-hit infrastructure
items.summary: New Delhi is prepared to consider Nepal’s proposals for assistance and reconstruction projects following the Bhotekoshi flood.
